d: Manchester City put five past AEK Athens in the UEFA Champions League, Phil Foden scored a hat-trick, and yet everyone was talking about the stands. Over 20,000 empty seats at the Etihad, just days after a packed stadium saw that Premier League anthem protest linked to the club's financial charges case. City deny any wrongdoing, they've appealed the findings, and sporting sanctions are still hanging over them. So were those empty seats a sign fans are losing faith in the owners, or just a midweek European game at a bigger stadium? City are winning on the pitch, but Rupha Ramani looks at…
